body.name: Moving row QTE law
body.construction:
For each \(P\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm S}\), evaluate \(H_{a,n}\), \(H_n\), and \(\ell_{a,n}=H_{a,n}/H_n\) under \(P\), and denote the resulting quantities by \(H_{a,P,n}\), \(H_{P,n}\), and \(\ell_{a,P,n}\).  Let \((L_{0,P},L_{1,P})\) have the following candidate joint arm-limit law.  If \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm H}\), its \(a\)-th marginal is \(\mathsf Z_{a,\theta,P}/f_{a,P}\), with \(\mathsf Z_{a,\theta,P}\) constructed by \(\text{def:oracle-limit}\) from the parameters of \(P\).  If \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm G}\), its \(a\)-th marginal is centered Gaussian with covariance induced by \(\mathrm{IF}_{a,P}\).  Two heavy marginals and a heavy--Gaussian pair are assigned the product law, while two Gaussian marginals are assigned the centered joint Gaussian law with cross-covariance \(E_P[\mathrm{IF}_{0,P}\mathrm{IF}_{1,P}^{\top}]\).  Define the moving row variable
\[
Z_{P,n}=\ell_{1,P,n}L_{1,P}-\ell_{0,P,n}L_{0,P}.
\]
This definition names the candidate row law; the convergence and the asserted product or covariance structure are conclusions of \(\text{thm:joint-qte}\), not premises supplied by the definition.
inputs: the two arm normalizations and arm limit constructions
